client: Luna, I've been feeling really overwhelmed lately because of my job. I just got assigned this challenging project with a tight deadline, and on top of that, my team is short-staffed. It feels like there's so much pressure, and I'm not sure how to handle it all. I worry that therapy might not even help with these work-related stressors.
therapist:
It sounds like you're really feeling the weight of your job responsibilities right now, especially with the added stress of a challenging project and a short-staffed team. That pressure can be incredibly overwhelming, and it's understandable to feel uncertain about how to manage it all. 

You mentioned that you're worried therapy might not help with these work-related stressors. I'm curious about that. What do you think it is about your situation that makes you feel therapy might not be effective? Sometimes, even when we’re feeling overwhelmed, there can be aspects we might not fully acknowledge. I wonder if there are deeper feelings or fears about this situation that you haven't had a chance to express yet.
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, moderate volume, moderate-paced speech
